Saves settings, stream profiles, host settings, favourites, filters and groups, corrected metadata and Home Assistant entities. Pairing with hosts is not included; on a new device pair the hosts first.

Resets the launcher: library, settings, pairings and credentials are deleted.

Everything the launcher stores is deleted: library, play times, metadata, settings, stream profiles, paired hosts and credentials. Back up first if you want to keep anything. The launcher closes afterwards.

Own filters, groups and chip order for games and apps

Game filters and groups appear as chips in the library and optionally as rows on the home screen. The eye shows or hides a chip, drag the handle to change the order. Default filters are ordinary filters: edit, hide or delete them like your own.
One chip/row per value, e.g. per platform
Pick entries here or add them via X → Groups.
Volume, sound style, events, vibration strength

App filters and groups appear as chips in the Apps tab and optionally as rows on the home screen. The eye shows or hides a chip, drag the handle to change the order. Default filters are ordinary filters: edit, hide or delete them like your own.

Apply to all controllers and to every stream profile that doesn't set them itself
Without a fixed player, the order of the first button press in the stream decides. Fixed players need „Automatic controller detection“ to be on.
Applied from the next stream on for this controller, taking precedence over the stream profile. “As in the profile” uses the active stream profile's value.

Detects your configured controller button combinations in every app and in the stream (Android Home, quick menu). Only controller buttons are read, nothing on the screen.
Record a single button (e.g. Guide) or a combination (e.g. Select + Start). In the stream only the last pressed button of a combination is held back from the host.
Hold the buttons together, then release them. Cancels after 10 seconds.
A, B or a D-pad direction alone are needed for navigation.
This combination is already used for the other action.
Hold the buttons together on this controller, then release them. Cancels after 10 seconds.

Placeholders: %ROMSAF%1$ (file as URI), %ROM%2$ (file path), %BASENAME%3$ (file name without extension). Extras separated by ";" as name=value, other types with bool:, int: or long: in front.
Emulator start commands and packages from ES-DE (https://es-de.org), MIT License. Details under Settings → About → Open source licenses.

Covers, backgrounds and logos come from SteamGridDB; descriptions, genres, developer, publisher, series, features, age ratings and release dates from IGDB. Add them below as sources: with your own keys, through a metadata server or through the host.
Your own keys are used first (shortest way), then metadata servers, then hosts; when one is not reachable or can't answer, the next one is used. Host games always take the data of their host.
